meta_description: Prior authorization turnaround down 62% — clinical evidence assembled automatically.

blocks.x: Prior authorization turnaround down 62% — clinical evidence assembled automatically
A national health insurer — Healthcare & Life Sciences engagement delivered by a 17-person team over 12 months, US scope, commercial model: outcome-linked.

items: Prior-auth requests bounced for evidence that existed in clinical notes; SLA breaches and provider revolt.
Claims codes and clinical narratives never reconciled; coding integrity audits painful.
Medical-policy grounding inconsistent across decision paths.

blocks.x: The prior-auth agent maps policy criteria to chart evidence, assembles submissions and appeals with citations, and routes true judgment calls to clinicians. Claims-clinical reconciliation on Forge now feeds coding-integrity and quality reporting with lineage; coverage decisions cite policy passages with provenance on Nexus.

Delivery followed the standard rhythm — Diagnose with a signed baseline, Prove with falsifiable criteria, Industrialize with staged rollouts — while the control evidence (model cards, decision replay, security tests) accumulated as artifacts of the build.

items: Connected machines to connected margin — service revenue attach up 3x
Research throughput up 2.8x — governed HPC/cloud platform

blocks.x: Towers: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation, Data, Analytics & Lakehouse, Applied AI & Generative AI. Platforms: Achala Swarm, Achala Nexus, Achala Forge.

items: the decision/data architecture pattern, the control matrix and the run model — adapted per estate in weeks, not quarters.
organizational absorption: adoption paths are designed for each client's operating culture, never assumed.

blocks.x: Client identity withheld under confidentiality. Metrics are reported against the baseline locked in the Diagnose phase; measurement method available under NDA.
Ask for a reference conversation on this pattern — or map it to your estate in a briefing.
